defects: Activity is 「活动名称：免费体检」 but footer says 「欢迎参加社区长者营养课堂」: the event is described two different ways
Poster is set in a 社区卫生服务中心 waiting area, but the host is 「齐齐哈尔市金沙区养老服务中心」; a free check-up in 「文化广场」 is odd but plausible
Subtitle 「食物多样，少量多餐，细软易消化」 is repeated word for word as a bullet
Unintended contradiction: 「【产品类型】压片糖果」 vs 「本品为固体饮料（泡腾片）」 in 注意事项 (the dissolve-and-drink directions also fit a solid beverage)
Shelf-life tamper cannot be seen in the image: 「【保质期】36个月」 and 「【保质期至】2029年10月12日」 (from 2026-10-13) agree with each other, so there is nothing to detect
The 产品特点 box lists both 「钙来源」 and 「高钙」: two different claim levels for the same nutrient (17% NRV per 100mL meets 高钙)
Subtitle 「餐餐有蔬菜，每天300～500克，深色蔬菜占1/2」 is repeated as a bullet (cosmetic)
The nutrition table has no header row or basis (the 每100g/每片 and NRV% columns are never named); the model must make up the header even though a 'complete boxed table' is required
「资料来源：市场监管投诉举报热线」 is an unusual thing to cite as a source
The 4:3 layout has only three content blocks (左上/右上/左下) and no 右下 block
Product type 「速冻生制熟制品（速冻水饺）」 is garbled: it should be 生制品 or 熟制品, and 「需煮熟后食用」 implies 生制品
Subtitle 「配料按加入量递减顺序排列」 is repeated as a bullet (cosmetic)
Unintended contradiction in a clean sample: 碳酸钙 is in the ingredients but the table shows 「钙｜0 mg｜0%」
「蛋白质｜0 g」 and 「脂肪｜0 g」 despite 植物油 (3rd ingredient) and 全脂乳粉: borderline under the per-5g basis
Shelf-life tamper cannot be seen in the image: 「保质期：12个月」 and 「保质期至：2027-12-06」 (from 2026-12-07) agree, so only the two standard numbers and the nutrition table are real anomalies
Brand 「晨牧日记」 (a dairy/pasture-style name) is a weak fit for 辣条
The label claims 「添加牛磺酸与B族维生素」 (维生素B6、B12、烟酰胺), but the nutrition table does not declare the fortified vitamins, which fortified foods are expected to do
A taurine/caffeine energy drink is typed 「风味饮料」; 特殊用途饮料 would be more usual
The nutrition table has no header row or basis (每粒 vs 每100g is never given)
「能量｜0 kJ」 next to 「脂肪｜0.4 g」 (≈15 kJ), and 0.1g/0.4g values are not rounded to 0: rounding is inconsistent
「适宜人群：成人」 clashes with the cartoon child-themed bottle (小脑袋插画) and 「请在成人看护下食用」 (this was already in the original)
「剂型：粉剂」 vs the product name 「…菊粉颗粒」 (颗粒剂)
「规格：425g×4瓶/箱」 is an unusually small pack count for a warehouse carton (pedantic)
The tamper 'removed 委托 relationship' is only weakly detectable: a brand plus a separate named manufacturer with no 委托 line can look normal
Unintended contradiction in a clean sample: 「原味乳酸菌饮品（非活菌型）」 vs 产品特点 「冷链配送，活菌新鲜」; the 2—10℃ storage and 30天 shelf life also match a live-culture product
「小瓶装」/「红色小胖瓶」 vs 「净含量：340mL」
